# #523 — Langfuse observation sink: ship captured turns to Langfuse as a second, best-effort lane

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-03T17:10:07Z
Updated: 2026-08-03T17:29:26Z
Closed: 2026-08-03T17:29:26Z

---

## What

Add Langfuse as a second sink in the Python capture app: every turn the Stop/SubagentStop capture already reads gets emitted to the fleet Langfuse server (https://langfuse.rodaddy.live, v3.173.0, RUNNING — canary trace `ae7545c1789335f61f0046889655d0a4` proven 2026-08-03) as content-ful session traces, for observation/debugging. Open Brain stays the memory authority; Langfuse is the flight recorder — and per Rico (2026-08-03), eventually the durable full-fidelity archive that lets the local raw-turn TTL (per the resolved retention design cited in `_plans/issues/395-dream-6-weekly-discard-drain.md:38`) actually fire.

This is deliberately a CONTENT-FUL lane, distinct from #372's content-free telemetry spec. Operator decision 2026-08-03: full transcript content (minus secrets) goes to Langfuse; the langfuse LXC is inside the backup surface.

## Design (delta on the existing capture spine)

Existing design this builds on, not replaces:
- `apps/capture/deliver.py:9-13` — watermark advances only after the lane call returns (`docs/decisions/capture-never-drops-a-turn.md`)
- `apps/hooks/session.py:426-476` — `run_stop` owns lane lifecycle; entrypoint swallows all (`apps/hooks/stop.py` observer contract)
- `WatermarkStore` keyed by arbitrary session key; subagent already uses its own key (`session.py` `watermark_key`)
- `config.py` `_SECTION_MODELS` + per-hook section loaders (`load_capture_settings` pattern)
- `apps/capture/redaction.py` — client-side value masking, currently unused on the live path because the OB server owns redaction (`apps/capture/__init__.py:21`)

Delta:
1. **`ObservationSettings`** section in `config.py` (registered in `_SECTION_MODELS`, own `load_observation_settings`): `enabled` (default False), `endpoint`, `public_key`, `secret_key` (SecretStr), `hmac_secret` (SecretStr, declared so the provisioned var stops being an "unknown-variable" typo; reserved for the #372 lane, unused here). All optional; use-time enforcement, same as capture/canon. Endpoint normalizes away the `/api/public/ingestion` suffix the provisioned env value carries.
2. **`apps/capture/observe.py`** — observation delivery: reads turns since its OWN watermark key (`observe:` prefix) via the same `read_since` + `WatermarkStore`, applies `redact()` per turn (Langfuse gets no server-side redaction), emits one Langfuse trace per delivery (session-grouped via `propagate_attributes(session_id=...)`, SDK v4 ≥4.14), advances the observe watermark only after flush returns. Emitter is a Protocol (like `RawLane`) so tests inject a fake.
3. **Wiring** in `run_stop` / `run_subagent_stop`: after the OB delivery, best-effort observation delivery in its own try/except — a Langfuse failure is logged content-free (class name only) and never affects the OB delivery or raises out. Independent watermark = independent at-least-once retry.
4. **Dependency**: `langfuse` (v4) in `python/openbrain`.
5. **Deploy step (not in-repo)**: the deployed `openbrain-hook-env` wrapper (see `docs/420-cutover-rollback.md`) currently passes only `OPENBRAIN_BASE_URL`/`OPENBRAIN_TOKEN`; it gains the `OPENBRAIN_OBSERVATION_*` pass-throughs once the config declares them. Fleet copies tracked by `_plans/fleet-rollout-0.9.md`.

## Non-goals

- No change to the OB lane, its watermark, or the never-drops rule.
- No Langfuse trace-ID backref into `ob_raw_turns` yet (that is the follow-up that wires the #395 discard path to the external archive).
- No #372 content-free metric lane.

## Verification

- Fake-emitter tests: disabled = no-op; redaction applied; observe watermark not advanced on emit failure; OB delivery unaffected by emit failure; settings alias resolution.
- Live: one real Stop on this machine produces a session trace in Langfuse UI.
